change: Micrometer — Expose configured timer percentiles across reporting steps
deployment: Pinned timer class over Micrometer 1.10.0 and SignalFx 1.0.25. The real registry publishes protobuf to a fresh loopback receiver with scheduled export disabled.
assumptions: Clock advances by exactly one minute per interval. The same registered timer and five-minute percentile window span both. Only an in-process loopback receiver accepts the emitted batches.

questions.observer: Decode actual wire counts, totals, bucket labels and deltas, and quantile gauge labels and numeric values on two intervals.
questions.basis: Counts and totals are sums of the four known samples. Delta buckets use only the new interval. The numeric percentile gauge must equal a separate SimpleMeterRegistry histogram on the same inputs.

questions.observer: Compare cumulative buckets and both percentile gauges, and a delta profile with no configured quantiles.
questions.basis: The cumulative buckets add both intervals. The independent timer supplies both percentile values. Unconfigured intervals emit zero phi gauges.
